### [`title_screen`](../../../../src/data/title_picture_5c00.asm#L6) `$5C00-$5FE7`

*data*

<a id="title_screen_tail"></a>
### [`title_screen_tail`](../../../../src/data/title_picture_5c00.asm#L130) `$5FE8-$5FFF`

*data*

24 bytes after the screen data that nothing reads (the last 8 are $60-$67 at the sprite pointers).

<a id="title_bitmap"></a>
### [`title_bitmap`](../../../../src/data/title_picture_5c00.asm#L134) `$6000-$7F3F`

*data*

Title picture: the multicolour bitmap. The program uses $6000-$7f3f as the bitmap of the picture that the user paints.

### [`title_file_tail`](../../../../src/data/title_picture_5c00.asm#L1125) `$7F40-$7F43`

*data*

The last 4 bytes of the KTITLE file, after the bitmap. Nothing reads them.
